title: Normalized deformation comparisons commute with coefficient reduction
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $r\geq m\geq1$, $A=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$, $B=\mathbf Z/\ell^m\mathbf Z$, and $S$ a Noetherian scheme (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]) on which $\ell$ is invertible. Let $g:V\to S$ be smooth separated of finite type and pure relative dimension $d\geq0$, and let $s:S\hookrightarrow V$ be a closed regular section of codimension $d$. Assume the normal bundle $\pi:N_s\to S$ and deformation family $\widetilde g:D\to\mathbf A^1_S$, with section $\widetilde s$, and their compactifiability hypotheses are those specified in [lem-pur-noetherian-etale-section-specialization]. For $R=A,B$, work in the ordinary etale $R$-module derived categories; put $C_R=s^*\omega_{g,R}$ and $F_R=\widetilde s^*\omega_{\widetilde g,R}$, with $\omega_{h,R}=h_R^\times R_{\operatorname{target}(h)}$. Write $a:\mathbf A^1_S\to S$ and $i_j:S\to\mathbf A^1_S$ for $t=j$, $j=0,1$. Let $\kappa_R:F_R\xrightarrow{\sim}a^*C_R$ be the normalized isomorphism whose restriction at $1$ is the identity, and put $\delta_R=(i_0^*\kappa_R)^{-1}:C_R\to z^*\omega_{\pi,R}$. Write $S_T=(-)\otimes_A^LB$. For any morphisms
$$e_F:S_{\mathbf A^1_S}F_A\to F_B,\qquad e_C:S_SC_A\to C_B$$
whose restrictions at $t=1$ agree under the canonical fibre identifications, one has
$$\kappa_B\circ e_F=a^*e_C\circ S_{\mathbf A^1_S}(\kappa_A).$$
With $e_0=i_0^*e_F$ under the normal-fibre identifications, this implies
$$\delta_B\circ e_C=e_0\circ S_S(\delta_A).$$
The morphisms $e_F,e_C,e_0$ are not required to be invertible. More generally, restriction along $i_1$ is injective on morphisms $a^*L\to a^*M$ for finite locally constant $B$-module sheaves $L,M$ locally free of rank one on $S$, and on morphisms between their equal shifts in the ordinary derived category.
